Close the left fingers around the clock after a short descent, then test retention with a small lift.

Advance the open fingers around the clock center while lowering slightly, then close and pause to avoid sweeping it sideways.
Lift the centered clock with the gripper closed, retracting slightly to maintain reach margin; check it follows.

Carry the retained clock over the drawer's front-top region at clearance height; hold orientation steady and inspect the landing area.

Move the retained clock farther inside the drawer top boundary and lower gently, keeping the elbow configuration continuous.

Shift the left fingers off the broad torso onto the exposed head, lower a short distance, and close for another retention test.
Test the new figurine grasp by lifting vertically with the left fingers closed; retention remains uncertain.

Clear the shoulder obstruction and move the open grasp toward the head visible below the fingertips in the wrist image.
